artworks.title: Large Landscape with a Ruined Abbey
artworks.artist: Gabriel Perelle
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image features a detailed architectural scene across a river. The horizon separates the architecture and trees from the landscape beyond. On the left are towering architectural ruins and large trees framing the scene. Detailed etching techniques show texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic. Small figures populate the scene, and water flows amidst reeds closest to us.

artworks.title: La simple Nature
artworks.artist: Francois-Nicolas Martinet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor gathering with a nature theme. It depicts a lush, wooded landscape with trees forming a canopy. In the center and towards the top, cloud-born figures float above. On the ground, various figures are gathered, dressed in flowing garments, engaging in a festive or social occasion. Some hold musical instruments and others wear floral wreaths. The scene includes decorative elements, a pedestal on the right, and peacefully integrated animals. The composition conveys a tranquil and celebratory atmosphere, capturing leisure and nature's splendor.

artworks.title: Decorative Panels
artworks.artist: Peter Flötner
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows black shapes on a white background arranged into two rectangles and two circles. The designs within these shapes consist of swirling, interlocking lines. The circles suggest mandalas or floral designs, while the rectangles resemble decorative borders in architectural designs. The style is elaborate and reminiscent of antique engravings or intricate filigree in jewelry.

artworks.title: Anton Triest
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode II after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a half-body portrait. He is seated and facing slightly to the side but looking at the viewer. The man has a beard and mustache, short and wavy hair with a receding hairline. He is wearing a voluminous robe, holding a section of it in one hand, and wearing a ring on one finger. The background shows textured, architectural elements indoors.

artworks.title: La Forêt
artworks.artist: Antoine de Marcenay de Ghuy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest scene with a winding path disappearing into the distance. The brushstrokes are intricate, creating rich textures and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, utilizing varying shades of ink. Tall trees with lush canopies are depicted in the foreground. A small figure can be seen walking along the path in the distance.

artworks.title: River Landscape with an Angler
artworks.artist: Antoine de Marcenay de Ghuy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon, featuring a structure resembling a small castle or fort on a hill in the distance. Large trees with dense foliage frame the right side, and two figures sit near water, possibly fishing or resting. A river or lake stretches across the scene bordered by vegetation. The style is detailed with fine line work depicting natural textures like rocks, trees, and water. The color palette is monochromatic, varying in shades of black lines to create depth and detail.

artworks.title: Landscape with Cave Opening
artworks.artist: Antoine de Marcenay de Ghuy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a sheet with four black and white etchings of landscape scenes. The top etching labeled "No. 49" includes trees framing a path leading into the distance. The second etching, "No. 50," depicts figures under a canopy of trees in a wooded area. The third etching, "No. 51," features a building on a rocky outcrop by calm water. The fourth etching, "No. 52," displays trees on the left and water on the right. The style uses fine lines to create textures and contrast, and the tonal palette is monochrome.

artworks.title: The Seven Maccabean Brothers Killed by Antiochus
artworks.artist: Crispijn van de Passe I after Maarten de Vos
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 20.3 x 15.2 cm (8 x 6 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in an intense scene. The central focus is on a large cauldron, with a muscular figure inside. Surrounding them are many other figures on foot and horseback, holding various weapons. Banners are waving overhead, suggesting a battle or conflict. The background features architectural elements, hinting at a fortress or castle on a hill. The style of the drawing is highly detailed, typical of late Renaissance art, with intricate linework and dramatic emphasis on musculature and expressive postures.

artworks.title: Eleazar Burned by Antiochus
artworks.artist: Crispijn van de Passe I after Maarten de Vos
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 20.2 x 15.2 cm (7 15/16 x 6 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man bound to a stake, surrounded by flames and onlookers. The central figure is tied to a stake amidst rising flames. Around him, multiple other figures are present, with some in armor or holding weapons. There are also individuals stoking the fire with long poles. The composition is detailed with linework, capturing the drama of the event. Light and shadow are used to enhance the intensity of the scene.

artworks.title: The Rape of Europa
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a woman riding a bull through the sea. The woman is elegantly dressed, with flowing drapery, and is seated on the back of the bull as it strides through the waves. In the background, a group of figures and more cattle are gathered on the shore, observing the scene. Dramatic clouds fill the sky, adding movement and drama. The drawing features detailed lines and hatching to depict texture and depth in the waves and fabrics, conveying the dynamic and fantastical nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Apollo Entrusting Chiron with the Education of Asclepius
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: plate: 18.5 x 26 cm (7 5/16 x 10 1/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a centaur presenting a child to a standing figure. The image depicts a mythical scene with the centaur extending an arm towards the human figure who is holding the child. The scene is set in a natural environment with trees in the background and a building to the side. The composition shows rich texture and detailed anatomy of the figures, created through cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Mars and Venus Surprised
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The drawing shows a god-like figure emitting light. The scene includes a couple on a bed, surrounded by other figures. The style resembles Renaissance engravings with detailed line work and expressive characters. The scene may depict a classical mythology story with symbolic elements like a winged figure and rays of light.

artworks.title: Thisbe Frightened by the Lion
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 x 26 cm (7 5/16 x 10 1/4 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a woman running with a landscape in the background. The woman is in motion with her garments flowing. In the background, there are trees, a mountainous terrain, and a temple-like structure. The sky has a swirling cloud pattern. The scene is depicted in black, white, and gray colors with detailed cross-hatching and linear strokes creating texture and depth.

artworks.title: Salmacis and Hermaphroditus
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.9 x 25.6 cm (7 1/16 x 10 1/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The scene depicts a landscape with two figures: one sitting on a rock and the other embracing them from behind. In the background, there is a mountain range that slopes down to the right, leading to structures resembling an ancient city. The image uses monochromatic colors and detailed textures, with engraved-like brushstrokes creating a serene atmosphere. Rolling hills and trees surround the figures, while wispy clouds adorn the sky above.

artworks.title: Apollo Abusing Leucothoe
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals in an intimate setting. One person, standing, is leaning over another seated on the edge of a draped canopy bed. The standing figure appears to have flowing hair and a light halo around the head. This person is partially draped in a loose garment, while the seated figure has wavy hair and a gentle expression. The seated individual is nude, except for a piece of cloth draped around the legs. No jewelry or adornments are visible on the figures. The room is intricately decorated with classical elements, such as a long cushioned bench, multiple windows, and a niche with a statue. A figure is in the background, entering through a doorway. The space also includes architectural features like a coffered ceiling and framed art or carvings on the walls, creating a setting reminiscent of historical or mythological scenes.

artworks.title: Juno in the Form of Beroe, Warning Semele
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two women seated facing each other in conversation. The first woman on the left wears a headscarf and a long dress, gesturing with her right hand. The second woman on the right has styled hair and wears a similar dress, gently resting her hand on her chest. Between them is a detailed cushion or mound. Two decorative urns with plants are beside them. In the background is a large building with classical architectural elements, trees, and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: The Dragon Devouring the Companions of Cadmus
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg

artworks.title: The Dispute between Jupiter and Juno
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. There are various figures and objects depicted in the scene. Two seated figures appear to be in conversation in the foreground; one has a crown and the other is wearing elaborate attire with draped fabric. The central setting is surrounded by clouds with cherubic figures and an eagle above. In the background, there is a banquet table with dishes and other items, attended by various figures. Additional figures and activities are depicted further in the distance, with a large open landscape visible beyond. The drawing is highly detailed, using intricate lines and shading to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Fall of Phaeton
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring divine beings and a chest. The artwork displays dynamic movement and expressive figures. The central focus is a cloud surrounded by ethereal beings, some with wings and flowing drapery. A grand chest is positioned prominently, appearing to spill its contents. The composition includes swirling clouds and dynamic lines. The background features intricate details like a crescent moon and an obscured landscape.

artworks.title: Phaeton's Sisters Changed into Poplars, and Cygnus into a Swan
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 x 26 cm (7 5/16 x 10 1/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The image features several tree-like figures, some with human features and garments. In the center, a figure draped in robes interacts with another figure turning into a tree. The background shows classical architecture with a large closed door adorned with gnarled branches and leaves. To the right, a swan is standing on a riverbank. In the sky above, there is a winged figure. The artwork showcases classic mythological motifs and is drawn with fine lines and detailed cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Jupiter and the Gods Asking Helios to Resume Control of the Chariot
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in classical attire under a cloudy sky. The scene features multiple figures in flowing robes, with one standing on a cloud-like form on the right, engaging with a group of others on the left. The figures appear to be in animated discussion, with gestures suggesting a narrative or dialogue. Detailed rendering of the fabrics, expressive poses, and use of hatching give the drawing depth and texture, enhancing the classical and dramatic atmosphere. The composition and style suggest influence from classical mythology or historical themes, with an emphasis on storytelling through posture and expression.

artworks.title: Juno Turning Callisto into a Bear
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing featuring two mythological figures, animals, and a landscape. The artwork shows two figures in the foreground - one standing and holding the other by the hair, who is on the ground. The scene includes swirling clouds above, peacocks with their feathers spread, a pastoral setting with trees, hills, and a distant city, as well as a large animal near a stream. The artist has used intricate lines and cross-hatching to create depth, texture, and shadow in a baroque style composition.

artworks.title: Juno Complaining to Oceanus and Tethys about Callisto
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 x 26 cm (7 5/16 x 10 1/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a mythological scene with sea creatures and divine figures. The drawing shows a figure wielding a trident rising from waves on a sea creature, a regal figure riding a chariot pulled by sea creatures, and a reclining figure against another sea creature. In the background are ships on the horizon under a celestial sky, creating a dramatic and fantastical atmosphere. The intricate lines and textures enhance the scene's movement and energy, typical of classical mythology.

artworks.title: Apollo and Coronis
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 x 26 cm (7 5/16 x 10 1/4 in.), trimmed to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image is a black and white engraving showing a scenic vista. Two people are close to us in a pastoral setting. Mountains rise from an elevated horizon line, leading to distant structures with smoke rising. The intricate etching highlights textures through cross-hatching and line work. The sky has swirling cloud formations with expressive lines. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes shading and contrast. Birds perch on branches to the right, observing sailors near boats.
